purpose: Synthetic diagnostics only until separately approved; never establishes customer validity
generator_owner: evaluation harness, independent of fitted candidate output

generators.law: monthly demand 1000; incumbent/candidate costs 1/0.6, latency 100/100, accepted true, critical false
constant request outcomes as above; independent monthly demand 1000/2000 with mass 1/2 each
shared case state easy/hard with mass 4/5,1/5; easy incumbent/candidate (cost,latency,accepted,critical)=(1,100,1,0)/(0.6,80,1,0); hard=(3,400,1,0)/(2,800,0,1)
constant world except candidate has state (20,5000,0,1) with probability 1/1000, independently by case
cohort left/right mass 1/2 each; incumbent (1,100,1,0); candidate left (0.6,80,1,0), right (0.4,300,0,1)
constant costs; candidate failure probability rises linearly from 0 at month 0 to 1/5 at month 35
constant world through month 23; candidate cost 1.2 and failure probability 1/5 from month 24
correlated world with only 12 independent training units per month
correlated world; hide all hard candidate outcomes; missing values stay missing

training.holdout_policy: chronological; fit only months 0..23; calibration predictions made before each observed calibration month

metrics: unsafe recommendation rate against known finite law
baselines: measured deterministic paired comparison with no predictive assurances

uncertainty.proportions: two-sided 95% Wilson interval over independent replication-level indicators
uncertainty.continuous: replication-level mean, sample SD, and 95% Student-t interval; no pooling months as independent

multiplicity: Descriptive intervals are explicitly unadjusted and cannot be release gates; any confirmatory family and thresholds need a separately approved version before execution
calibration_controls: biased mean plus 25% of true mean with unchanged width
interval width reduced to 10% around true mean

causal.assignment: independent Bernoulli 1/2 before outcomes, stored unit IDs
causal.potential_outcomes: baseline cost 1 or 2 with equal mass; null Y1=Y0; known-effect Y1=Y0-0.2
causal.supported: known randomized assignment with independent complete units and no contamination
causal.unsupported: unrecorded concurrent changes and MNAR cannot be identified from observed outcomes alone; report explicit limitation rather than passing integrity

expected_behavior: Missing evidence and unsupported integrity cannot silently yield safe assurances. Drift/small-sample outputs are diagnostic, not a calibrated-forecast certification.
adversarial_review: Synthetic generators may miss real dependence and label errors; safer fallback is measured deterministic comparison and explicit abstention. Numerical thresholds and sample counts here are experiment design choices, not customer sufficiency claims.
